programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 1: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Drama with James Earl Jones. A widower opens a reading room, where people can learn to read. But despite his goodwill, problems in the neighbourhood threaten his establishment.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: An Accidental Studio
programme.desc: Dr. Jane Waterleigh participates in an experiment in projected perception when she takes an experimental drug. She envision a futuristic society run by women. In this society all men have gone extinct because of a genetic accident caused by her associate Dr. Hillyer. After regaining consciousness, Dr. Waterleigh attempts to alter the future by killing Dr. Hillyer before he can progress further in his dangerous experiments. Her efforts prove futile, however, when Dr. Hillyer's son becomes determined to carry out his father's work.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Widow Mary Bassett (Helene Joy) and her 3 children have hit difficult times on their farm; it is especially apparent when they cannot even afford a turkey meat for their Thanksgiving dinner. Oldest daughter Tilly (Tatiana Maslany) writes to Mary's wealthy and estranged mother Isabella (Jacqueline Bisset), exaggerating their situation in a lengthy letter. Isabella comes to the farm to offer her help and finds a kindred spirit in Tilly. However, Mary resents her mother's attempts to help them out of their financial difficulties.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: The eighth season of Fear begins after the conclusion of Season 7, when Morgan's (Lennie James) and Madison's (Kim Dickens) hopes to rescue Mo from PADRE did not go as planned. Now, Morgan, Madison and the others they brought to the island are living under PADRE's cynical rule. With our characters demoralized and dejected, the task of reigniting belief in a better world rests with the person Morgan and Madison set out to rescue in the first place -- Morgan's daughter, Mo.

An earthquake reaching a 10.5 magnitude on the Richter scale, strikes the west coast of the U.S. and Canada. A large portion of land falls into the ocean, and the situation is worsened by aftershocks and tsunami.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, the responsible gang stops by the home of one of their band's estranged wife to abduct his own young son. The town's old sheriff (Patrick Duffy) calls for the help of a retired gunfighter (Stacy Keach), who is also the abducted boy's grandfather. Hot on the trail of the fugitives, they discover that two bounty hunters are already in pursuit of the gang for crimes committed in Mexico.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: TVmovie about a widowed police officer and his rebellious teenage daughter who move from Los Angeles to the wilds of Montana. Awed by the beauty of the countryside but dismayed by the lack of urban amenities, the pair struggle to adapt to their new ranching lifestyle.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Caesar watches as the slave and gladiator, Tyrannus, slaughters his competitors, unaware that Cassius and Brutus -- Caesar's ""friends"" -- plan to assassinate him shortly, an event foretold by the psychic vestal virgin, Camane. After the assassination, Caesar's murderers seek to take over the empire, but standing in their way is a will naming Caesar's nephew, Octavius, as heir. Keeping a promise made to Caesar, Tyrannus spirits Octavius away from those who now want him dead.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Marc Antony addresses the crowd at Caesar's funeral, where a shroud hides the deceased leader's stab wounds. Octavius' mother, Atia, recently imprisoned by Cassius, is allowed to speak at Caesar's funeral, but she tells the wild crowd that her son is Caesar's true heir. Meanwhile Camane, the psychic vestal virgin, has put her own life at risk by guarding the will, and Tyrannus, fearing for Octavius' life, once again takes the young heir away from the turbulence of Rome.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

programme.title: Stranger with My Face
programme.desc: After the death of her father, Laurie and her mother and sister make their summer vacation house their permanent residence. After starting school, Laurie's friends see her in places where she wasn't, and accuse her of doing things she didn't do. Her own sister even accuses her of trying to choke her in her sleep.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Crusoe
programme.desc: This historically faithful drama challenges the morals of the time as Crusoe, now an American slave trader, confronts a "Friday" who is his equal. Renowned cinematographer Caleb Deschanel directs in visually spectacular style.

programme.title: The Inspectors
programme.desc: The series stars Jessica Lundy as a United States Postal Inspection Service who investigates crimes relating to United States Postal Service mail. The show also focuses on her personal life as a single mom with a son who became a paraplegic in the same crash that killed his father, also a postal inspector. At the end of each episode, Lundy and the Chief U.S. Postal Inspector, Guy Cottrell, give viewers tips on how to avoid being a victim of a scam similar to the episode.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: To escape evils of the Civil War, Cyrus removes his small family and random war prisoners by way of hot air balloon. Once landing on an island, the group finds they are surrounded by danger from giant insects and gold-craving pirates. Turned away by the only safe haven on the island, owned by Captain Nemo the group is forced to find shelter and survive.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Camane posts signs around Rome claiming that Octavius is Caesar's rightful heir. Under Tyrannus's protection Octavius is on the run because Cassius wishes him dead. The two are captured by mercenaries and put into a gladiator's prison where they will face certain death if their true identities are revealed.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Epic four-hour series about the rise of Octavius who succeeds Julius Caesar and tangles with Marc Anthony for control of the Roman empire and finally went on to become the emperor Augustus.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: The ship is becalmed and another vessel is sighted, which turns out to be British - the Alcyone, whose commander announces that the war with France is over. The two vessels anchor alongside and a ball is held for the passengers. Here Edmund meets the sweet Marion Chumley, though he has a rival for affections in Deverel. However, when the two ships part Deverel is exchanged for the Alcyone's officer, the urbane Benet and Edmund confides in Summers his regret at having to say goodbye to Marion. A storm blows up, during which the unfortunate steward Wheeler, considered a Jonah, is thrown overboard and Prettiman severely injured, being nursed rather unexpectedly by Miss Grnham. A mast is also broken and Benet and Summers disagree over the best way to mend it.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Widow Mary Bassett (Helene Joy) and her 3 children have hit difficult times on their farm; it is especially apparent when they cannot even afford a turkey meat for their Thanksgiving dinner. Oldest daughter Tilly (Tatiana Maslany) writes to Mary's wealthy and estranged mother Isabella (Jacqueline Bisset), exaggerating their situation in a lengthy letter. Isabella comes to the farm to offer her help and finds a kindred spirit in Tilly. However, Mary resents her mother's attempts to help them out of their financial difficulties.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, the responsible gang stops by the home of one of their band's estranged wife to abduct his own young son. The town's old sheriff (Patrick Duffy) calls for the help of a retired gunfighter (Stacy Keach), who is also the abducted boy's grandfather. Hot on the trail of the fugitives, they discover that two bounty hunters are already in pursuit of the gang for crimes committed in Mexico.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Drama with James Earl Jones. A widower opens a reading room, where people can learn to read. But despite his goodwill, problems in the neighbourhood threaten his establishment.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Camane, the beautiful Vestal Virgin, saves Octavius' life after he is bitten by a poisonous snake. When Marc Antony's soldiers arrive suddenly to assassinate Octavius, Camane puts herself in harm's way so the young Emperor can escape and hopefully claim his throne.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Octavius relinquishes the beautiful Vestal Virgin, Camane, so that he can devote himself to being the Emperor of Rome. Tyrannus, the former slave and gladiator, joins Octavius' forces in their fight against the power-hungry Marc Antony, with the fate of Rome and the western world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Olympiacos" - "Hapoel"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Valencia" - "Panathinaikos"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: It is one of Earths few landforms visible from space, a World Heritage site, and one of Americas most popular National Park with over nearly five million visitors a year. But at the edge of a chasm, visitors see only a tiny fraction of the Grand Canyons true beauty hidden amidst its stone, its water and its wildlife. Even for scientists it is a place of baffling mysteries. How and when was it actually formed? Why does one of the planets deadliest diseases still endure in the Canyons premier carnivore the majestic mountain lion? What drove one of the largest birds on earth, the California Condor, to the brink of extinction? Why do microscopic colonies of vegetation that bind the desert sand where no other plant can survive take years to regenerate from the pressure of a single human footfall. And finally what of the Canyons earliest human inhabitants? Where did they live? How did they survive? National Geographic Television joins a rare scientific odyssey down the Grand Canyons entire 277-mile length through some of the most treacherous rapids on the planet to try to unlock the mysteries of this great unknown. A select group of scientists and experts will show us a Grand Canyon few outsiders ever see. From the river still cutting through two-billion-year-old stone to the creatures roaming its incomparable back-country, the Grand Canyon still has secrets to tell.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: Far in the Pacific, 250 miles from Honolulu, a hidden wilderness teems with life ... the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. In 2006, the islands were declared a national monument, in large part because of the area's more than 7,000 marine species. In this special, come aboard a voyage led by scientists from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration who are researching disease-plagued coral reefs, endangered monk seals and the millions of birds nesting in the volcanic islands and atolls.

programme.desc: Enchanted Islands. We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: The Incredible Honey Badger
programme.desc: Honey badgers live a life of fearless confrontation. From the very beginning, they go through nature's ultimate boot camp. These small, curious creatures take stings from scorpions and endure swarms of angry bees—all lessons that strengthen them against far more lethal threats. Over time, they develop an almost supernatural resilience to venom and pain. Honey badgers take on predators many times their size, from lions to leopards. To survive, these resilient animals rely on sharp senses, loose skin, and an unbreakable fighting spirit. Through astonishing footage of real-life confrontations, we see how each brush with death refines the honey badger's fearlessness. Their myth becomes reality as we watch one of nature's toughest living legends and discover what truly makes them so invincible.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Along Australia's spectacular coastline, a new generation of animals is beginning life. Meet playful Australian sea lion pups mastering life on rocky shores, loggerhead turtle hatchlings racing toward the ocean under the cover of darkness, and pelican chicks growing up in bustling seaside colonies. High above the waves, young osprey nestlings prepare for their first flights. Beneath the surface, baby sea dragons drift among seaweed and young sharks learn to hunt in coral reefs and shallow coastal waters. Farther offshore, humpback whale calves stay close to their mothers as they embark on epic migrations and discover the rhythms of life at sea. Through first swims, first flights, family lessons and extraordinary journeys, these coastal babies learn the skills that will help them thrive in Australia's wild and watery world.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive. Watch wild brumby foals find their footing in rugged bushland, while peewee chicks, bush stone-curlew chicks and monarch butterfly caterpillars face their own unique challenges on the path to adulthood. From learning what to eat and how to avoid danger to mastering essential skills through play, exploration and family guidance, every youngster must prepare for life on its own. Along the way, witness extraordinary transformations, incredible parenting strategies and surprising survival adaptations found nowhere else in the world.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: It is one of Earths few landforms visible from space, a World Heritage site, and one of Americas most popular National Park with over nearly five million visitors a year. But at the edge of a chasm, visitors see only a tiny fraction of the Grand Canyons true beauty hidden amidst its stone, its water and its wildlife. Even for scientists it is a place of baffling mysteries. How and when was it actually formed? Why does one of the planets deadliest diseases still endure in the Canyons premier carnivore the majestic mountain lion? What drove one of the largest birds on earth, the California Condor, to the brink of extinction? Why do microscopic colonies of vegetation that bind the desert sand where no other plant can survive take years to regenerate from the pressure of a single human footfall. And finally what of the Canyons earliest human inhabitants? Where did they live? How did they survive? National Geographic Television joins a rare scientific odyssey down the Grand Canyons entire 277-mile length through some of the most treacherous rapids on the planet to try to unlock the mysteries of this great unknown. A select group of scientists and experts will show us a Grand Canyon few outsiders ever see. From the river still cutting through two-billion-year-old stone to the creatures roaming its incomparable back-country, the Grand Canyon still has secrets to tell.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Nella the Princess Knight is a British-American animated children's television series that follows adventurous life of fun-loving and fearless princess Nella who turns into a knight when necessary in order to protect her kingdom. Her main treasure is not her crown but her beloved friends- unicorn Trinket, steed Clod and Sir Garrett. Nella sees that no harm comes to her friends and all other citizens of her kingdom. Together with her friends they have fun, solve mysteries and overcome hardships without which life is impossible even in the happiest kingdom.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Kid Stuff:After discovering a long-forgotten T.U.F.F. rule that prohibits agents from using their blasters in the presence of children, Snaptrap begins bringing kids to the scene of all of his crimes. By disguising Keswick as a beloved children's TV star, Dudley and Kitty are able to lure the kids to safety and foil Snaptrap's plan.Super Duper Crime Busters:A documentary-style TV show spends a day profiling T.U.F.F. and its super-star agents, but much to the agents' embarrassment, the television crew arrives on the most boring day at T.U.F.F. Can the T.U.F.F. agents make the television crew impressed in T.U.F.F., or will the television crew consider T.U.F.F. the most boring agency?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: On their way back from Lake World, the Wylde Paks get stuck in a massive traffic jam. The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

Un generale prende in ostaggio un gruppo di turisti nella prigione di Alcatraz e minaccia di far esplodere San Francisco. Un agente dell'FBI esperto di armi chimiche e un ex agente dei servizi segreti inglesi, l'unico ad esser mai fuggito da Alcatraz, vengono ingaggiati dal governo per sventare il folle piano del militare che tiene la citta' sotto la minaccia di missili al gas nervino. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: 12 anni schiavo
programme.desc: Steve McQueen dirige Chiwetel Ejiofor e Michael Fassbender in un biopic premiato con 3 Oscar. Nella Louisiana dell'800, un violinista afroamericano viene rapito e ridotto in schiavitù.

programme.title: Il piccolo diavolo
programme.desc: Roberto Benigni al fianco di Walter Matthau in una commedia diventata cult. Quando un sacerdote americano esorcizza una donna, salta fuori uno scatenato diavoletto (ITA 1988).

programme.title: Il texano dagli occhi di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Leggendario western diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood. Alla fine della Guerra di Secessione, una banda di nordisti si accanisce contro un contadino sudista e la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Il mago del Cremlino - Le origini di Putin
programme.desc: Nel caos della Russia alla fine anni 90, Vadim Baranov, un produttore di reality show, diventa il braccio destro dell'oligarca Boris Berezovskij, che gli affida il compito di fare da spin doctor a un politico in rapida ascesa.

programme.title: War: Il divorzio del secolo
programme.desc: Lo studio emergente Taylor & Bryne e il prestigioso studio Cathcarts rafforzano la squadra della strategia legale. Carla comunica ai suoi avvocati Serena e Nick la sua intenzione di lasciare il marito senza un centesimo.

programme.title: War: Il divorzio del secolo
programme.desc: Morgan e Carla si preparano per la mediazione, ma una svista offre agli avvocati di lei l'occasione di contestare il loro accordo prematrimoniale. Tuttavia, gli avvocati di Morgan hanno un'arma segreta.

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Trovandosi in difficoltà a Los Angeles, l'ex pornostar Mikey Saber decide di tornare nella città natale di Texas City, dove nessuno sembra particolarmente entusiasta di rivederlo.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Speciale: Piedone 2, Uno sbirro a Napoli
programme.desc: Un accesso esclusivo al set della seconda stagione di Piedone in compagnia dei suoi protagonisti: Salvatore Esposito, Silvia D’Amico e Fabio Balsamo.

programme.title: La Grande Bellezza - Versione Integrale
programme.desc: Jep Gambardella, giornalista affermato, si muove tra i palazzi della Roma mondana in cui si celano vizio e degenerazione...

programme.title: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria...
programme.desc: La canzone che tutti cantano non è quella che Max e Mauro pensavano e insieme a un ritorno inaspettato avrà conseguenze inaspettate… come la vittoria del Festivalbar! \n.

programme.title: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria...
programme.desc: Esiste un lieto fine quando i sogni di due compagni di banco cambiano? Epico finale per la leggendaria storia degli 883!

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Johnny Stecchino
programme.desc: Capolavoro di comicita' diretto e interpretato dal premio Oscar Roberto Benigni. Nel duplice ruolo di un boss latitante e del suo sosia, l'attore toscano si trova coinvolto in una girandola di spassosi equivoci quando si innamora della moglie di un pentito che la mafia ha condannato a morte. La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

programme.title: Anniversary
programme.desc: Le tensioni salgono e le lealtà vengono messe alla prova, quando una coppia incontra la nuova fidanzata del figlio, una giovane radicale che fa parte di un movimento particolarmente controverso.

programme.title: Il filo del ricatto: Dead Man's Wire
programme.desc: Bill Skarsgård e Al Pacino nell'intenso film di Gus Van Sant ispirato a una storia vera. Per vendicarsi dei soprusi subiti, un uomo disperato prende un ostaggio in diretta TV.

programme.title: Addio, Signor Haffmann
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Gilles Lellouche e Sara Giraudeau in una pellicola nella Parigi dell'occupazione nazista. Un gioielliere ebreo cede il negozio a un dipendente in cambio di un nascondiglio.

programme.title: Lettere da Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: Inside Man: Most Wanted
programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapina la banca federale americana, dando inizio a un sequestro di dieci ore. Un esperto di negoziazione e un agente federale collaborano per salvare gli ostaggi e impedire la rapina.

programme.title: La rapina perfetta
programme.desc: Jason Statham nell'action che ricostruisce la storica rapina del 1972 ai danni della Baker Street Bank di Londra le cui dinamiche coinvolsero la mafia, il Governo e la Monarchia.

programme.title: (Im)perfetti criminali
programme.desc: Action-comedy Sky Original di Alessio Maria Federici. Quattro guardie giurate progettano un colpo grosso in gioielleria per aiutare uno di loro. Non mancheranno sorprese e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: Clive Owen, Denzel Washington e Jodie Foster in un thriller di Spike Lee. Una banda di rapinatori irrompe in una banca di New York. Un detective tratta la liberazione degli ostaggi.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence in un action dal regista di "Transformers". Due poliziotti braccano una banda di narcotrafficanti. L'unica che puo' aiutarli e' una prostituta che viene rapita.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence tornano in azione in un travolgente sequel diretto da Michael Bay. I due detective della Squadra Narcotici di Miami devono fermare un traffico di ecstasy.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga action con Will Smith e Martin Lawrence. I detective Mike e Marcus fanno di nuovo squadra per scoprire l'identita' di un sicario misterioso e vendicativo.

programme.title: Piedone - Uno sbirro a Napoli
programme.desc: Palmieri torna in servizio: indaga sull’omicidio di un’attivista mentre l’ombra di Iodice continua a pesare sul suo percorso.

programme.title: Now you see me - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Illusionismo e colpi di scena in un thriller con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo e Morgan Freeman. Quattro maghi inscenano spettacolari trucchi di magia, sempre connessi a giganteschi furti.

programme.title: (Im)perfetti criminali
programme.desc: Action-comedy Sky Original di Alessio Maria Federici. Quattro guardie giurate progettano un colpo grosso in gioielleria per aiutare uno di loro. Non mancheranno sorprese e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Twist
programme.desc: Moderna rilettura targata Sky Original del romanzo di Charles Dickens, con Rafferty Law e Michael Caine. Nella Londra di oggi, una gang di giovani criminali pianifica la rapina del secolo.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Parte 1
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della romantica saga tratta dai romanzi di Stephenie Meyer. Bella e Edward aspettano una bambina, la cui nascita stravolgera' gli equilibri fra i Cullen e i Volturi.

programme.title: Speciale: Piedone 2, Uno sbirro a Napoli
programme.desc: Un accesso esclusivo al set della seconda stagione di Piedone in compagnia dei suoi protagonisti: Salvatore Esposito, Silvia D’Amico e Fabio Balsamo.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn-Parte 2
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart e Robert Pattinson nell'epico atto finale La nascita di Renesmee ha scatenato la guerra tra i Cullen e i Volturi, preoccupati che il segreto dell'immortalita' venga svelato.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga romantica a tinte dark con Kristen Stewart e Robert Pattinson. Una ragazza introversa si innamora di un coetaneo che proviene da una stirpe di vampiri.

programme.title: Speciale: Piedone 2, Uno sbirro a Napoli
programme.desc: Un accesso esclusivo al set della seconda stagione di Piedone in compagnia dei suoi protagonisti: Salvatore Esposito, Silvia D’Amico e Fabio Balsamo.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart e Robert Pattinson nel secondo capitolo della saga di "Twilight". Abbandonata da Edward, Bella cerca conforto in Jacob, ignara della sua natura di licantropo.

programme.title: The Twilight saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo con Kirsten Stewart, Robert Pattinson e Taylor Lautner. Mentre un esercito di 'NeoNati' costringe vampiri e licantropi all'alleanza, Bella deve scegliere tra Edward e Jacob.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga romantica a tinte dark con Kristen Stewart e Robert Pattinson. Una ragazza introversa si innamora di un coetaneo che proviene da una stirpe di vampiri.

programme.title: Alla fine ci sei tu
programme.desc: Asa Butterfield e Maisie Williams in una storia di crescita. Un ragazzo ipocondriaco affronta le sue peggiori paure quando accetta di esaudire gli ultimi desideri di una coetanea malata.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Un film Minecraft
programme.desc: I formidabili Jason Momoa e Jack Black nel fantastico live action basato sull'omonimo videogame. Scaraventati attraverso un portale in un bizzarro paese delle meraviglie chiamato Overworld, quattro improvvisati avventurieri devono portare a termine una magica missione per tornare a casa.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Un gioiello di animazione diventato un classico. Un leone, una giraffa, un ippopotamo e una zebra evadono dallo zoo di New York per vivere rocambolesche avventure nella giungla.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Baby Boss
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Madagascar" una esilarante pellicola d'animazione della DreamWorks candidata agli Oscar 2018. L'arrivo di un fratellino dispotico stravolge la vita del giovane Tim.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: Wicked - Parte 2
programme.desc: Cynthia Erivo e Ariana Grande tornano protagoniste nel secondo capitolo fantasy. Elphaba e Glinda affrontano il percorso che le renderà leggendarie. Canzoni in lingua originale.

programme.title: Viaggio al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser nel remake di un classico degli anni 50. Tre esploratori si inoltrano sotto la superficie terrestre alla scoperta di un regno sconosciuto, abitato da minacciose creature.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Un gioiello di animazione diventato un classico. Un leone, una giraffa, un ippopotamo e una zebra evadono dallo zoo di New York per vivere rocambolesche avventure nella giungla.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulle pellicole prodotte da Illumination.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: La piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Oscar 2012 al miglior film d'animazione. Un bizzarro camaleonte giunge in una cittadina del selvaggio West oppressa dalla siccità e da una spietata banda di fuorilegge senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Madagascar 2
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo con il quartetto di animali fuggiti da New York. Alex il leone, Marty la zebra, Melman la giraffa e Gloria l'ippopotamo cercano di tornare a casa, ma finiscono in Africa.

programme.title: Baby Boss 2 - Affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Sequel dell'animazione di successo targata Dreamworks. Tim e Ted sono diventati adulti e si sono allontanati l'uno dall'altro, finche' una missione top secret non li costringe a riunirsi.

programme.title: Viaggio al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser nel remake di un classico degli anni 50. Tre esploratori si inoltrano sotto la superficie terrestre alla scoperta di un regno sconosciuto, abitato da minacciose creature.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari

Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.
